trap-nonspeakable.notes: VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY, and the arithmetic is CORRECT: I enumerated all 76 standard Young tableaux of size 6 and counted those pure for (sigma_1, sigma_3, sigma_5) — i.e. with {1,2}, {3,4}, {5,6} each row-adjacent (sym) or column-adjacent (alt). The count is exactly 20, and the eight patterns come out (sym,sym,sym) 4, (alt,sym,sym) 2, (sym,alt,sym) 1, (sym,sym,alt) 3, (alt,alt,sym) 3, (alt,sym,alt) 1, (sym,alt,alt) 2, (alt,alt,alt) 4 — matching tbl:...-table1-data row for row and the .ts authorNotes' middle-six (2,1,3,3,1,2). The torus-link identification also checks: the closure of sigma_1^k in B_2 is T(2,k), and T(2,4), T(2,6), T(2,8) all have 2 components since the exponents are even. Separate (non-trap) findings: (1) the two extracted data tables (tbl:hoefsmit-ew-cell-content-table1-data, tbl:hoefsmit-ew-cell-content-table2-data) declare uses[] back to this theorem, but this .md links NEITHER — a reader of the theorem never sees the multiplicities the "Statement (formal)" paragraph announces. The double blank line after that paragraph is where the table was lifted out. (2) uses[] is empty although the authorNotes name conj:force-carrier-knot-vs-link-dichotomy, conj:weak-spectral-completeness and prop:weak-symmetric-normalization. (3) Block kind: the authorNotes open "**Open.**" and describe the W/Z/H-to-strand-pair assignment as "currently a structural proposal"; per AGENTS.md 3b that content belongs in a `conjecture`, or the theorem must be restricted to the tableau arithmetic (which is what is actually proved).

lean-no-definitional-laundering.evidence: folio/quantum-observable-universe/mass-theory/hoefsmit-ew-cell-content.lean:173: `EWIdempotentsIdentified` takes 3 argument groups and its body is the constant `True`. It is a name reserved for a claim, not the claim: it is equal to every other tautology, so anything stated in terms of it — an iff, a hypothesis, a downstream theorem — is discharged by `Iff.rfl` / `trivial` and constrains nothing. Seal the body (`opaque`) or state the real proposition with a `sorry` so `#print axioms` can see the gap.
